A '''star'''<ref name="Tessent">{{GamerCite|9|Race for the Tessent}}</ref> was located in the [[Maya Kovel system/Legends|Maya Kovel system]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Maya Kovel/Legends|Maya Kovel]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. After the Ayrou renounced their ''[[il Madri]]'' religious tradition and the hierarchs of the tradition's chapterhouses declared their accumulated wealth taboo, the contents of some chapterhouses' treasure vaults were loaded aboard [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and shot into Maya Kovel's [[Star/Legends|sun]].<ref name="Tessent" />
